storefront_adapter_repository.role: FalseTech Resale Wix storefront adapter only

runtime.backend: FastAPI + SQLite compatibility layer + PostgreSQL shared canonical state
runtime.shared_data: Supabase/PostgreSQL through authenticated RLS-enforced FalseTech API
runtime.object_storage: private Supabase Storage for safe shareable artifacts
runtime.sync_model: event-based offline-capable synchronization; never file-sync live SQLite databases

shared_data_platform.security: RLS enabled; client RPCs security-invoker; anon RPC execution revoked; security advisor clean

device_policy.setup: one-time Windows installer per PC; PWA login/install on phone

artifact_naming_policy: Opaque/hash/UUID-style user-facing filenames must be replaced with readable canonical names when safe; preserve original name, path and hash in provenance.
capabilities: recoverable soft delete and audit logging
market fee and expected seller-net routing
per-PC SQLite cache and offline event queue
automatic Windows background discovery and synchronization
phone Continuity PWA with search, device status, recent changes, and private file access
human-readable artifact naming with rename provenance
continuity_policy: REUSE -> CONTINUE -> EXTEND -> INTEGRATE -> MERGE -> REFACTOR -> BUILD NEW
private_data_policy: Never commit local inventory databases, uploads, private inventory JSON, exports, credentials, refresh tokens, or device secrets to the public repository.
